hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.py$'; then ruff format "$file_path"; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read file_path; if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.py$'; then ruff check "$file_path"; fi; }

hooks.prompt:
Evaluate whether the Claude Code should stop working. Context: $ARGUMENTS

Ensure all code changes has test covered and pass the tests. All user requirements are met. Approve changes if not code changes or user requirements are missing.
